verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents handling inbound calls from third-party carriers (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, SIP), which call the bot's webhook. Its development runner terminates telephony WebSockets, and the site advertises SIP/PSTN transports. Phone numbers and call routing appear to come from the external carrier, not Pipecat's own API. missing for 10: phone-number provisioning through Pipecat's API, documented outbound calling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of telephony flows.
